liked_artists = {}  # artist_id -> name
page_index = 0
all_songs_count = 0
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=token, page_index=page_index)
    print('page', page_index, 'type', type(res), 'len', (len(res) if hasattr(res,'__len__') else None))
    if not res:
        break
    all_songs_count += len(res)
    for song in res:
        for a in song.get('artists', []):
            liked_artists[a['id']] = a.get('name')
    page_index += 1

print('unique liked artists', len(liked_artists))
print('sample artist ids', list(liked_artists.keys())[:10])

print('have liked_artists', 'liked_artists' in globals(), 'len', (len(liked_artists) if 'liked_artists' in globals() else None))

liked_ids = set(liked_artists.keys())
following_ids = set(following.keys())
missing_ids = sorted(liked_ids - following_ids)
print('liked unique artists:', len(liked_ids))
print('already following artists:', len(following_ids))
print('missing to follow:', len(missing_ids))
print('missing ids + names:', [(i, liked_artists.get(i)) for i in missing_ids])

results=[]
for artist_id in missing_ids:
    resp = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
    results.append((artist_id, resp))
    print('follow', artist_id, '->', resp)

print('followed count', len(results))
